description: Secret-free synthetic regression streams. Protocol-correct event projections; not live captures. Recorded live controls remain in each harness directory.

codex: https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/protocol/src/protocol.rs (TokenCountEvent, TokenUsageInfo, RateLimitSnapshot, RateLimitWindow; native token_count payload and rollout event_msg wrapper)
grok: ../../../src/grok/protocol_test.lua (existing streaming-json protocol cases: text.data chunks, usage, end.stopReason)

https://docs.x.ai/docs/api-reference/chat-completions (OpenAI-compatible usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens; synthetic detail fields on the existing CLI usage event)
pi: @mariozechner/pi-ai/dist/types.d.ts: AssistantMessageEvent.contentIndex, AssistantMessage.model, Usage.cacheWrite and Usage.cost.total; @mariozechner/pi-agent-core/dist/types.d.ts: message_start/update/end

cases.claude_messages: Two distinct message IDs with identical text; full snapshots correct short deltas.
cases.claude_rejected: Rejected five_hour window and failed result; retryable rate-limit error.
cases.claude_warning: allowed_warning normalization, explicit per-window status and overage.
cases.codex_stream: Two cumulative token-count observations must not double count; item.updated corrected by item.completed. Exec final counters omit reasoning retained from token_count.
cases.grok_stream: Delta-only protocol, OpenAI usage detail fields, no reported cost/model/limits.
cases.pi_stream: Short delta corrected by message_end, cost and model usage.
cases.pi_messages: Distinct messages with identical text, two models; reported zeros retained and unreported reasoning stays absent.
cases.pi_nonstream: message_end without preceding partial messages still emits full content.
